name: The Walking Spring
description: A spring the archive records at a fixed point, and a line of dead stonework saying otherwise.
arrival: The water comes out of the hillside cold enough to hurt. Forty paces downslope there is a stone basin, dry, well made, and obviously built to catch exactly this. Forty paces further there is another.
notes: Geography and botany both. The dry basins are the evidence and they are visible on arrival -- the player can see the answer before they can explain it, which is the right order.
